description: Add E2E tests for a Tauri 2.0 desktop app — skill must NOT route to Playwright. Tauri renders in the OS webview (WKWebView / WebView2 / WebKitGTK), which Playwright cannot attach to. The official route is WebDriver via WebdriverIO + @wdio/tauri-service. The previous version of this fixture asserted the opposite and locked in a wrong answer.

context.task: Write E2E tests for a Tauri 2.0 desktop app with embedded WebView UI
